factual_errors.text: A straight-line graph through the origin; the two quantities are directly proportional
factual_errors.correction: A linear relationship gives a straight-line graph. It does not have to pass through the origin. Only a straight line that passes through the origin shows direct proportionality. The same wording appears in keyPoints[2].content ("A linear relationship gives a straight line through the origin"), keyPoints[2].writeBullets[3] and revisionCardBullets[5]. These suggest that 'linear' and 'directly proportional' mean the same thing.

checkpoint_mismatch.key_point: keyPoints[3].content: "Up to the limit of proportionality, you can work out the energy stored with this equation."
checkpoint_mismatch.why: The question says only that the spring "is not inelastically deformed". The key point allows Ee = ½ke² only up to the limit of proportionality. A spring can deform elastically beyond the limit of proportionality. So the condition given in the question does not support using the equation. The question should say that the limit of proportionality is not exceeded.
